name: search_products
description: Full-text product search on carrefour.it (Spesa Online), through the FactFinder search the site itself links to. Returns products with EAN, name, brand, price, unit price, size, category and product URL, plus next_start when more results exist. Prices and availability depend on the store selected in the session.

start.description: Index of the first product to return, for pagination (0, 25, 50, ...). Use next_start from the previous page.
